entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Even if it was with my self-imposed[n]handicap, I'm impressed that you beat[n]me. You've become quite skilled.
It's thanks to you.
I couldn't let myself lose.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Coming from anyone else... that would[n]have sounded like sarcasm. Though that[n]only makes it sting even more...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I see. So we even share that perspective,[n]do we...? You truly are fascinating.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Remember when I said before that[n]you and I are similar?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We're both victims of unjust adults. And[n]now, we have the will and power to[n]rise up against them.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yet I'm doing so as a detective, and[n]you're acting as a phantom thief. Our[n]stances couldn't be more different.
But we're teammates now.
You want to join us?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...For now, yes.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But even that united front will soon end.[n]And after that, everything will return[n]to the way it was, no?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha, is that a serious question?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why not join me instead...? All you'd[n]have to do is abandon the teammates[n]you have now.
Akechi's eyes are deadly serious.[n]I need to give him a real answer...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: How about it?
I'll think about it.
I'm not doing that.
You're my rival.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh? So you'll think about it, at least?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...But I'd advise you don't say these[n]things without their due consideration.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You shouldn't make promises that you[n]can't keep, anyway.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I thought as much.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm sure you understand. We all have[n]our parts to play, and we can't simply[n]leave those behind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: *chuckle* You truly are intriguing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I agree. I think a relationship of equals[n]suits us better than being co-conspirators,[n]anyway...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...No matter what else may change.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: In any case, what you just said carries[n]great weight. Remember what you[n]decided, and don't run from it. All right?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Cut label

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Cut label

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That said, as long as we're working[n]together, you'll have my strength.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Rest assured, I'll do my part. You'll find[n]me very useful indeed.
I feel like my bond with[n]Akechi is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, that reminds me. I did say that if you[n]ever beat me using my right hand, I'd[n]face you with all my ability...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Well. I'll keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well then, farewell for now.
